purpose: Fixed adjudication corpus for the Experience hard-gate semantic boundary. Every case is checked against both enforcement layers: the Python runner (scripts/scoring_protocol/experience_runner.py) and the Dashboard import boundary (src/lib/experienceScoringPolicy.ts). The two must agree on every case.
coverageBoundary: These layers are mechanical. They bind a decision to exact source text, a recognized absolute-bar cue, and an inventory comparison, and they refuse excluded requirement categories, stated experience ranges, and explicit waiver language. They cannot judge every remaining question of whether prose is substantive — the `notMechanicallyEnforced` cases record where the prompt is still the only thing standing between a bad phrasing and a zero. Those cases are the argument for running a real model canary before the next bulk batch.

expectations.reject: must be refused; `rejectLabel` names the excluded category when the refusal is a category exclusion
expectations.notMechanicallyEnforced: passes both mechanical layers today; only the prompt prevents it
